title: Actseal post-publication receipt (schema 1, promotion profile)
description: postpublish-receipt.json written by `tools/check_release.py postpublish` after installing the published version from the official PyPI index in the pinned clean container. The promotion profile requires the official index and file host, non-yanked metadata, both distributions with provenance present, and the exact demo/replay smoke outcomes (demo 0 with bad BLOCK and fixed PASS, fixed replay 0, bad replay 1). A local or test-index run (for example a `file://` index or a run that allowed missing attestations) is inspection-only and never validates. The provenance fields record that PEP 740 attestation presence, trusted-publisher identity and statement subjects were inspected; they do not claim cryptographic verification. Unknown fields are rejected everywhere; the helper additionally enforces exact integer counts, inventory equality with the verified distributions and the Production/Stable classifier for 1.x.

InspectionNote.const: Attestation presence, publisher identity and statement subjects were inspected; no independent cryptographic verification is claimed.

PublishedMetadata.description: The PyPI `info` facts that must equal the downloaded wheel's METADATA: project name, version, summary and the sorted classifier list; the release must not be yanked.

Publisher.description: The only trusted publisher identity accepted: this repository's `publish-pypi.yml` workflow in the `pypi` environment.

Provenance.description: Inspection record for one published file. `attestations` counts the PyPI Publish attestations whose decoded statement named this file and its digest; it is at least the number of publisher bundles. No signature or certificate is verified here.

PublishedFiles.description: Exactly the wheel and the sdist, sorted by filename. The helper additionally requires `sha256 == declared_sha256 == provenance.subject_sha256` per file and equality with the verified build inventory.

SmokeChecks.description: The frozen installed-demo expectations recorded from the clean-container run.

EmbeddedPostpublish.description: The post-publication evidence as embedded in the release receipt: the same body without the receipt-level schema_version, kind, version and ok fields, which the release receipt carries itself.
